notes.title: Introducing Next Game of RE Atelier
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/44139594/1d812d917798fd790a7a86633ccea3f91be56798.png[/img]

White Blade, the next game of RE Atelier, is almost complete.
We are introducing a trailer for White Blade.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OnupJC3ZBNE


White Blade, a game developed 10 years ago and distributed for free in 2014,
is expected to be released on Steam with enhanced content and graphics.

White Blade will be released on Steam in approximately 3 weeks.
We are working to complete the development process as soon as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update: June 9, 2022
notes.content:
* Some misses with rhythm have been corrected. (small mistake between the beats, about 0.005s ~ 0.033s)

* Some event graphics have been modified.

* Artworks at Steam store page are changed and added.
